sn33.55:1.4: the cosmos is eternal, or not eternal …
sn33.55:1.5: or a realized one neither still exists nor no longer exists after death.
sn33.55:1.7: the cosmos is eternal, or not eternal, or finite, or infinite; the soul and the body are one and the same, or the soul is one thing, the body another; after death, a realized one still exists, or no longer exists, or both still exists and no longer exists, or neither still exists nor no longer exists.”
